title: Arancia Julius, a Harvey Wallbanger Riff
ldName: Arancia Julius, a Harvey Wallbanger Riff
ldInstructionsRaw: Combine everything except the soda water in a tin and shake with ice. In the bottom of a Collins glass, pour 1/2 oz. of soda water. Strain the contents of the shaker tin into the Collins glass on top of the soda and add ice to fill the glass. Top with the remaining 1/2 oz. soda.
